summary: Provision gated Confluence space + ephemeral Slack groups for external partner collaboration
description:
Issue summary:
Request: create a gated Confluence space and a matching set of ephemeral Slack channels/groups to support short-term collaboration with an external partner (AcmeHealth). The workspace must enforce approval workflows for guest access, automated retention and export of all audit logs for 90 days, and an automated teardown after 60 days unless extended by SRE/Product.

Impact:
Product and solutions teams need a secure, low-friction collaboration surface to exchange design docs and test prompts with an external partner. Current ad-hoc guest access is creating scattered docs and compliance concerns. A standardized, automated workspace reduces manual provisioning overhead and audit risk.

Requirements / Acceptance criteria (high level):
- A Confluence space named "partners/acmehealth-<project-slug>" with space permissions locked to: product_owner (edit), engineering_lead (edit), external_guests (view/comment only after approval).
- Slack workspace provisioning in our org with channel naming convention #acme-<project-slug>-<purpose> and auto-creation of these channels: #acme-<slug>-general, #acme-<slug>-ops, #acme-<slug>-design. Channels must be private and invite-only.
- An approval flow in Jira for guest invites that: (a) records requester, approver, reason, and TTL; (b) notifies #security-approvals and product_owner; (c) creates audit entry in Confluence space with timestamp and approver.
- Automatic guest expiry after 60 days with email to approver at 7 days before expiry to request extension.
- Automated daily export of Confluence audit logs and Slack channel membership lists to secure S3 bucket with 90-day retention.
- RBAC mapping to our Okta group for partners that restricts access to only the provisioned space and channels (no global read).
- On teardown, Confluence space and Slack channels are moved to an archival project and retained for 365 days according to policy; a final export of content is taken.

Business justification:
Supports a time-bound pilot with AcmeHealth for a HIPAA-related eval. Security and compliance team require documented approvals and automated audit exports. This reduces manual work for Platform and Security and prevents inconsistent guest permissions.

Notes / Constraints:
- This must conform to our partner data handling playbook and HIPAA checklist (see linked confluence pages).
- Prefer using existing automation services (we have a Slack provisioning Lambda + Confluence REST automation library). If new scripts are required, they must be checked by Security and stored in the infra repo with CI checks.

Requested timeline:
- Target: workspace and basic automation live within 3 business days for pilot kickoff. Full audit/export and expiry automation within 10 business days.

Contact for follow-up: Rina Patel (Product), Jordan Kim (Eng lead), Priya Rao (Security)

Slack private channels #acme-acme-pilot-general, #acme-acme-pilot-ops, #acme-acme-pilot-design created and visible only to invited members.
Guest invites flow created in Jira that records approver and TTL and triggers Okta SCIM creation of partner group.
Automated daily exports of Confluence audit logs and Slack membership lists delivered to s3://redwood-partner-exports/acme-pilot/ with server-side encryption and 90-day lifecycle rule.
Guest accounts auto-expire at 60 days and trigger reminder email 7 days prior to approver.
